rules.rule: A breaking change (type!: or a BREAKING CHANGE: footer) bumps major, feat bumps minor, anything else bumps patch; the version is the last version tag bumped so.
--bump major|minor|patch overrides the inference, and the run names the override next to the version it generates.
--exclude drops commits by short hash before bump inference.
The section holds the conventional commits since the last version tag.
Types map to sections via changelog.types; a hidden type is tracked and never listed; an empty table means the default table.
With changelog.showScope true, each commit's scope is in its entry.
The first release covers the whole history from an implied v0.0.0, and its entry links to the tag's commits rather than a compare.
Each version file's root version field is spliced in place, formatting preserved.
The hook receives $VERSION with no v prefix.
The hook receives $VERSION with no v prefix.
The tag's name is the Release-Tag trailer on HEAD.
The hook receives $VERSION (no v) and $TAG (with it).
